author: PavelMakarchuk
body:
## Diagnosis

The bug is in `de_agi_joint.py` — it floors each spouse's income at zero before summing, so the primary's SE loss (-$49K) gets discarded instead of offsetting the spouse's income ($74K).

| Item | PE (current) | TaxAct (correct) |
|------|-------------|-----------------|
| Federal AGI | $25,959 | $25,959 |
| DE AGI | $73,636 | $24,043 |
| DE income tax | $3,194 | ~$0 |

### Fix

Tracked in PolicyEngine/policyengine-us#7869
